svg.text: (a) hand fit in the page's fit tool - trusted: the 21 hand fits are the reference the gate is measured against
then the same spot on the map
The page solves the same similarity for its preview; pipeline/plan_fit.py decides. Pairs are never moved or snapped. A DELETE runs the old all-fits sweep (a removed overlay leaves the map).
Hand saves bypass the gate (PLAN.md assumption 1): the owner's drag is the authority. A fit is saved only with one point more than fixes it (3 for a plan, 5 for a view).
Hand fits so far: 21 documents by: hand (20 golden in tests/golden/hand_fit_docs.sha256 + Maiden Castle 2026-10-11); no script changes or deletes them.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Iowan Old Style', serif

the old overlay, drawing on the map first)
309: queue pairs a drawing with the right place,
not a namesake (Devil's Dyke Brighton vs Cambs)
304: fit the plan against the old survey sheet
